thread:
Maya Chen: Quick sync — customer asks for a lightweight observability slice we can ship in Q2. Need to pick tradeoffs: sampling rate for traces, cost breakdown granularity (per-route vs per-model), and an error analytics MVP. Can folks weigh in with must-haves vs nice-to-haves?

Ajay Patel: Must-have: per-route latency histogram in the console (p95/p99). Without that customers won't trust rollout decisions. Nice-to-have: per-model cost split, but per-route is higher priority.

Sam Kim: Agree on p95/p99. For traces: must-have is a simple trace link from an error event -> full trace (no sampling UI initially). Nice-to-have: build trace sampling UI later.

Leanne Ortiz: From enterprise customers: we need an acceptance gate — cost alerts when estimated monthly spend delta > 15%. That can be an opt-in. Also request for hashed user id redaction in traces (compliance).

Maya Chen: Noted. On sampling: do we default to 10% tail-based sampling + on-demand full trace fetch? That keeps cost down but gives investigatability.

Ajay Patel: 10% tail-based sounds fine. Make sure we surface the sampling rate in the UI and in API responses. Customers will ask why some traces are missing.

Sam Kim: For error analytics MVP: grouped stack traces, top N error fingerprints, and actionable hints (e.g., retry vs bad input). We can initially power hints with a simple heuristics layer (rule-based).

Leanne Ortiz: For cost breakdown, per-route + per-model (for hosted API) is the minimum. Per-tenant later. Also need export to CSV for finance teams.

Maya Chen: Good. Proposed launch criteria for the MVP (shipable): 1) Dashboard with per-route latency & token cost per route, 2) Trace links from error events + 10% tail-based sampling, 3) Error analytics page with grouping & top 5 fingerprints, 4) Cost alert opt-in (15% delta). Anything blocking?

Ajay Patel: Blocker: infra work to tag requests with route/model metadata for billing. ETA ~2 sprints.

Sam Kim: Blocker: simple sampling + trace retrieval API needs seeding in runtime. Requesting eng-runtime help.

Leanne Ortiz: Compliance blocker: redact PII by default in traces. Ops-security OK to ship with PII redaction toggle disabled for new customers, must be on for enterprise.

ops-bot: Incident alert: perf-ci pipeline flaky tests related to tracer client — cc @eng-runtime.

Maya Chen: Action items: Ajay, coordinate billing tags with infra. Sam, draft trace retrieval API spec (small swagger). Leanne, write compliance checklist and toggles. I'll pull a short PRD and share in #product by EOD tomorrow. Thanks all :thumbsup:
